description: List sales quotes, filtered by status, customer, quote number or date range. Unleashed: GET /SalesQuotes/{page}.

customerCode.description: Only quotes whose customer code starts with this.

modifiedSince.description: Only records created or modified since this UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD).

pageSize.description: Records per page, 1-1000. Unleashed default is 200.

quoteNumber.description: Only the quote with this number (overrides other filters).
